DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH) with associated hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy.

The clinical picture of a 31-week preterm infant with chorioamnionitis, presenting with seizures, lethargy, hypotonia, and a tense anterior fontanelle, strongly supports this diagnosis. The history of low birth weight and poor Apgar scores further increases the risk of germinal matrix hemorrhage. Immediate neurosurgical consultation and management of intracranial pressure are indicated.
